source.author: verg
source.text: In freta dum fluvii current, dum montibus umbrae lustrabunt convexa, polus dum sidera pascet, semper honos nomenque tuum laudesque manebunt, quae me cumque vocant terrae.
source.text_original: In freta dum fluvii current, dum montibus umbrae / lustrabunt convexa, polus dum sidera pascet, / semper honos nomenque tuum laudesque manebunt, / quae me cumque vocant terrae.'
source.text_english: While the rivers run into the sea, while shadows shall traverse the mountain slopes, while the sky shall feed the stars, your honor and your name and praises shall always endure, whatever lands may call me.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Et in alio loco: In freta dum fluvii current, dum montibus umbrae Lustrabunt, convexa polus dum sidera pascet, Semper honos nomenque tuum laudesque manebunt.
reuse.text_original: Et in alio loco: In freta dum fluvii current, dum montibus umbrae Lustrabunt, convexa polus dum sidera pascet, Semper honos nomenque tuum laudesque manebunt.
reuse.text_english: And in another place: While rivers will run into the sea, while shadows will range over the mountains, while the sky will feed on the curved stars, your honor and name and praises shall always remain.
